plain: So plain and obvious it seems you could touch it, as in palpable tension

webster.text: Perceptible by the touch; that may be felt; as a palpable substance; palpable darkness.

more.text: Gross; coarse; easily perceived and detected; as a palpable absurdity.
Plain; obvious; easily perceptible; as palpable phenomena; palpable proof.

example.quote: The palpable necessity of the power to provide and maintain a navy has protected that part of the Constitution against a spirit of censure, which has spared few other parts.
